svg.title: SwiftServe onboarding illustrations, square, with the mascot
svg.desc: Two square onboarding illustrations. Left: a map with a radius around the user, three yellow location pins each holding the chubby mascot face in a yellow hard hat, and a worker card with the mascot as the avatar. Right: a worker profile with the mascot as avatar, skill chips, a charcoal new-booking card and coins.
svg.text: Screen 2: Turn your Skills into Opportunities
